overview.description: The State Street SPDR S&P Homebuilders ETF (XHB) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P Homebuilders Select Industry index. The fund tracks a broad-based, equal-weighted index of US companies involved in the homebuilding industry. XHB was launched on Jan 31, 2006 and is issued by State Street.
